svg.aria-label: Brick Breaker uplift: the friends set, as drafts
svg.title: Brick Breaker uplift: the friends set, as drafts
svg.text: Friends: levels 31 to 40
Brick Breaker uplift · the Friends set, as drafts · light palette
The garden · new: cage, plated brick, key brick, gate · no draft is a level until the autopilot has cleared it

g.text: a pip for each hit left
the last one opens the gates

svg.text: 40 Reunion
The set's last: three keys, a gate, six friends, and a fort for seven balls.
31 Hello
A cage: two hits free a friend, a ball
more.
47 bricks · 49 hits · star at a streak of 10
32 Mushroom
Plated bricks: a ball from below is
turned back, so the way in is up an
edge and down from the top.
61 bricks · 65 hits · star at a streak of 10
33 Drawbridge
Keys and gates: the last key opens
every gate at once.
60 bricks · 78 hits · star at a streak of 15
Levels 31 to 40, in the garden. Four kinds are new, one at a time:
the cage (31), the plated brick (32), and the key and its gate (33).
Each is met alone, then in a level built on it, then beside the others.
The ball's pace runs from 1.12 to 1.18, under the Finale's 1.2: the
set asks for thought, and leaves speed to the set after it.
34 Nest
Three friends freed inside a ring,
where they rattle.
47 bricks · 70 hits · star at a streak of 15
35 Stepping stones
A stair plated on its near side: the
soft side is up the right edge.
24 bricks · 25 hits · star at a streak of 10
36 Birdhouse
A picture: the friend waits inside the
house.
55 bricks · 84 hits · star at a streak of 15
37 Walled garden
The keys lie over the wall, and the
gate is its floor.
22 bricks · 22 hits · star at a streak of 15
38 Beehive
A picture: free the bee first and two
balls work the hive.
72 bricks · 84 hits · star at a streak of 20
39 Trellis
A mesh a ball threads, its plated
bricks open to a hit from the side.
44 bricks · 45 hits · star at a streak of 10
